privileged_info_for_vlm: The migration requires a Latitude shift of +0.0015 and a Longitude shift of -0.0022. Model mappings are: Old_Tanker -> Tanker_A; Old_Ferry -> Ferry_Pax_1; Old_Buoy -> Buoy_Cardinal_N. For Scenario_A, the original ownship coordinates (50.8, -1.1) should become (50.8015, -1.1022). All three scenarios must be moved to /opt/bridgecommand/Scenarios/ with the 'Migrated - ' prefix.
